title: Preview: fix SolidWorks thumbnail extraction, add AI/Visio, honest DipTrace note
acceptance_criteria: SolidWorks files whose thumbnails Windows shows also preview in SQ (full-stream signature scan plus SummaryInformation thumbnail with DIB-to-BMP); Illustrator .ai previews as PDF; Visio .vsd/.vsdx tries embedded thumbnails; DipTrace gets a clear export-suggestion note; tests cover each path
close_reason: Shipped 0.14.0: embedded-preview extraction rebuilt to mirror Windows (full-stream PNG/JPEG/BMP signature scan, SummaryInformation thumbnail property, DIB-in-metafile to BMP conversion), Visio vsd/vsdx thumbnails, Illustrator PDF-compatible files preview as PDF, DipTrace honest export note. Protolabs/Xometry comparison answered: they license commercial CAD kernels; not viable to vendor.

title: User documentation: MkDocs guide on GitHub Pages
acceptance_criteria: A docs/ MkDocs site covering install, boards (subtasks, statuses, recurrence, WIP), Today and displays (kiosk, Pi, ESP32, Android TV), attachments and previews (honest format table), AI features, integrations (HA, API keys, Claude Code), and administration; builds strict; deploys to GitHub Pages via Actions; the app links to it

title: Dedicated project overview pages
acceptance_criteria: Each project gets a full overview page (button from the board): description, open tasks, completed tasks, all files across the project, recent activity; projects gain an editable description
close_reason: Shipped 0.14.0: /project/{id}/overview with editable description (new column), open tasks with status/assignee/subtask progress, completed list, all project files with click-to-preview, recent activity; Overview button on the board.

title: Settings overhaul: left navigation, landing page, updates and hardware panes
acceptance_criteria: Settings uses a left sidebar layout (responsive: collapses on narrow screens), a landing pane with version/stats/health, panes for AI, General, Users and Access, Hardware (displays and connector), Backup, and Updates (current version, latest release check with graceful offline degradation), modeled on PantryRaider's settings-section structure
close_reason: Shipped 0.14.0: settings rebuilt as a left-sidebar pane layout (Overview landing with stats/health, AI, General, Users and Access, Hardware absorbing displays/token/connector, Backup, Updates with graceful-offline release check), responsive collapse under 800px, /displays redirects in.

title: Nested subtasks: children under parents, drag to nest and promote
acceptance_criteria: Subtasks are child cards nested under the parent on the board, collapsed by default with an expand toggle; dragging a card onto another card (or into its expanded sublist) nests it; dragging a child out to a column promotes it; one nesting level enforced; existing subtasks migrate to child cards losslessly; dialog subtask section keeps working against child cards
close_reason: Shipped 0.14.0: subtasks are child cards (parent_id), nested on the board collapsed by default with expand, drag onto a card or into its list to nest, drag out to promote, one level enforced, lossless migration from the subtasks table, parent delete promotes children.

title: Preview more file types: SolidWorks thumbnails, 3MF/OBJ in 3D, IGES, video, audio, ZIP
description: Dan asked for more preview coverage including SolidWorks and PDF. SolidWorks parts cannot be tessellated (proprietary format) but store an embedded thumbnail in their OLE container which olefile can extract; that is a real preview. 3MF and OBJ are open mesh formats convertible to STL server-side, reusing the existing WebGL viewer. IGES rides the vendored occt-import-js. PDF already previews via the browser's native viewer (verify, do not rebuild).
acceptance_criteria: SLDPRT/SLDASM show their embedded preview image when present (honest note otherwise); 3MF and OBJ render in the 3D viewer via server-side STL conversion; IGES tessellates like STEP; video and audio play inline; ZIP lists its contents; PDF confirmed working; all parsers unit-tested and the flows browser-verified
close_reason: Shipped 0.13.0: SolidWorks embedded thumbnail extraction via olefile (image preview with honest caveat, fallback note when absent), 3MF/OBJ server-side STL conversion (cached, transform-aware) rendering in the existing viewer, IGES via the vendored occt reader, video/audio players, zip content tables. PDF confirmed already working. 8 new tests, 3MF chain browser-verified with screenshot.

title: Card comments and activity log (Trello/Jira parity)
description: From the competitor evaluation: comments and an activity trail are the second parity gap that fits SQ's multi-user reality. One card_events table covers both.
acceptance_criteria: Card dialog shows an interleaved activity feed (created, moved, done, assigned, attached) plus user comments with author and time; viewers read but cannot comment; events survive export/import is NOT required (log is local history)

title: Card assignees (Trello/Jira parity)
description: From the competitor evaluation: Trello members and Jira assignee are the highest-value parity gap now that SQ is multi-user. Single assignee per card keeps it lightweight.
acceptance_criteria: A card takes one assignee from the user list; initials chip on the board; quick filter matches assignee; assignment recorded in card activity; works when no users exist (field hidden)

title: First-class subtasks on cards
description: Dan asked for subtasks on tasks. Checklists (description text) stay, but subtasks become first-class rows with their own table and API, richer than markdown lines: individually toggleable, reorderable, and visible as progress everywhere a card shows.
acceptance_criteria: Subtasks are rows (not description text): add, rename, toggle, delete, reorder in the card dialog; progress chip on board cards; included in kiosk data, handoff prompts, and export/import; AI subtask button creates real subtasks

title: AI research on cards + handoff prompt exports
description: An AI research assist that proposes ways to complete a card (approaches, steps, risks, tools) which can be appended to the description; and a handoff generator that packages the card (title, description, checklist state, project, due, attachments list) into a self-contained prompt with export options: copy, open in Claude (claude.ai/new?q=), open in ChatGPT, copy for Gemini, copy as a Claude Code shell command.
close_reason: Shipped in 0.11.0: AI research assist (approaches/steps/pitfalls markdown, append-to-card), and handoff exports packaging the full card into a prompt with Copy, Open in Claude (claude.ai/new?q=), Open in ChatGPT, Copy for Gemini, and Copy as Claude Code shell command; clipboard fallback for plain-http tablets.

title: Card attachments with drag-and-drop and a preview engine
description: Drag and drop any document onto a card (dialog dropzone and directly onto board cards): stored under data_dir/attachments, listed in the card dialog with a paperclip count chip on the board. Preview engine: CSV and Excel as tables, Word and text/code as text, images and PDF inline, STL rendered in-browser with a dependency-free WebGL viewer. STEP and SolidWorks get an informative fallback card (real tessellation is a separate bead).
close_reason: Shipped in 0.11.0: drag-and-drop attachments (dialog dropzone + drops directly on board cards, 100MB cap, uuid storage, cleanup on card/project delete, paperclip chips), preview engine (CSV/XLSX tables via openpyxl, DIY docx text extraction, text/code, images, PDF, dependency-free WebGL STL viewer with orbit/zoom; STEP/SLDPRT honest fallback). Browser-verified with headless Chromium screenshots.

title: Kiosk mode: simple day-first dashboard, per-device preference
description: A selectable kiosk mode that turns the front end into a simple dashboard prioritizing today's tasks: /kiosk page with big tap targets (tap = done/undone), clock, progress, overdue and stalest-project footer. Per-browser preference in localStorage with auto-redirect from normal pages and an exit control, so a tablet can live as a wall screen. Registered browser displays default to the kiosk page; display tokens may use the one narrow toggle endpoint so wall touchscreens work without a login.
close_reason: Shipped in 0.10.0: /kiosk dashboard (tap-to-done with recurring respawn, clock, progress, overdue and stalest footer), per-device localStorage preference with nav toggle + exit, registered browser displays default to kiosk with saved look params, display-token holders get exactly the toggle write.

title: Publish image to GHCR so updates become docker pull
description: The deployment server currently updates by re-copying source over SSH and rebuilding on the box. Add a GitHub Actions workflow publishing the ghcr.io image on release, then switch the server container to the published image (Watchtower-friendly). Was blocked while the repo was private (org Actions billing); the repo is public now, so run the workflow once manually and switch the deployment over.
notes: publish-image.yml is authored and committed (release-triggered + manual dispatch, pinned image name ghcr.io/syracuse3dprintingorg/projecttracker). Still blocked: org Actions billing refuses all workflow runs. Once Dan fixes Billing & plans, run the workflow once manually, then switch Korolev's container to the published image.
close_reason: Repo went public, Actions unblocked. publish-image.yml ran (workflow_dispatch) and pushed ghcr.io/syracuse3dprintingorg/projecttracker latest + 0.11.1; the package pulls anonymously. The deployment server now runs the published image (data volume untouched, health verified). Future updates: run the workflow (or cut a release) then docker pull + recreate, Watchtower-compatible.

title: Home Assistant integration
description: Connect SQ to Home Assistant. Expose Today's Tasks to HA (REST sensor: count, remaining, task list as attributes). Let HA drive the wall displays via service calls or webhooks. Optional: create cards from HA automations with a token auth story. Shipped in 0.9.0.
close_reason: Shipped in 0.9.0: /api/ha/summary for REST sensors, API keys (member/viewer, X-API-Key header, admin-managed in Settings), member-level TV display actions for automations, and ready-made homeassistant/sq.yaml with sensors, rest_commands, and an example automation.

title: Modern SolidWorks container preview (post-OLE format)
description: SolidWorks 2021+ files can use a sealed non-OLE container (dword2 0x04000000 signature family) with no raw or zlib-reachable preview image; Windows renders these via the SolidWorks shell extension. 0.14.1 detects and explains them honestly. Revisit if an open-source reader for the container appears, or consider a documented companion-export convention.
notes: 2026-07-23 experiment: scanned a real modern-container SLDPRT for raw-deflate streams at every offset in the header region looking for wrapped OLE or PNG; nothing. The container is sealed as suspected. Stays blocked pending an open-source reader.

title: Change kiosk mode to add links at bottom to "due soon" etc.
description: The layout as is is good but add some more info for a footer. Add the squirrel logo

title: Real STEP/SolidWorks preview via tessellation
description: 0.11.0 previews STL natively and shows a fallback card for STEP/SLDPRT. Real B-rep preview needs tessellation: evaluate vendoring occt-import-js (WASM, ~10MB, converts STEP/IGES/BREP to meshes client-side) against the no-CDN lightweight rule, or a server-side convert path. SolidWorks parts stay unsupported (proprietary); document exporting STEP or STL from SolidWorks.
acceptance_criteria: A .step/.stp attachment renders as a real 3D mesh in the preview dialog (vendored WASM tessellation, no CDN); SolidWorks parts keep the honest fallback; a test STEP file converts in the browser test
close_reason: Shipped 0.12.0: STEP/STP tessellate in-browser via vendored occt-import-js WASM (LGPL 2.1, licenses vendored), rendering through the existing viewer's new mountMesh path; SolidWorks keeps the honest fallback. Browser-verified with a real STEP cube, pixels confirmed lit, failure path verified.

title: Per-user Today lists with per-display selection
description: Now that SQ is multi-user (0.8.0), the Today list is still shared by the whole instance. Add an optional per-user Today list, and let each registered wall display choose whose list it shows (or the merged household list). Touches: cards.today ownership, /api/display payload, the Displays page look options, and the Today rail.
acceptance_criteria: Each user can keep a personal Today list alongside the shared one; every registered display (and the kiosk) can select whose list it shows (shared default); Plan my day fills the chooser's list; existing shared Today data untouched by the migration
close_reason: Shipped 0.12.0: user_today table alongside untouched shared cards.today, owner-aware store/API ('mine'/'shared', displays name user:<id>), rail selector with localStorage persistence, display/kiosk selection, Plan my day fills the chosen list. 12 new tests.
